method: Three separately seeded runs of the unchanged existing benchmark tool after the final recipe was frozen. All 15 pairings, same-seed seat swaps, normal difficulty, mixed styles, full setup, production node budget with wall-clock guard disabled. Pooled score and 2000-resample bootstrap across 60 seed/opponent seat-pair clusters per deck.
limits: Preset selection aims at playable starting decks, not optimal construction or proven global balance.
The two earlier 90-game iterations changed both the recipe and seed group. Their differences cannot establish a causal effect of any individual card.
The final construction was fixed before these three seed groups. All three groups are included, with no seed group discarded.
These are local normal-bot paired simulations, not independent product QA, human ladder outcomes or browser performance.
Random draws can still produce a run of actions; the new composition increases independent bodies rather than guaranteeing draw order.
Previously saved custom or old preset loadouts are not silently migrated.

matchedComparison.change: Only starter-05: one N05 replaced by N06. All education, Offer, action, flex choices and all other five presets unchanged.
causalLimits: This fixed-policy matched comparison estimates the whole-card substitution within these six presets and these seeds.
The replaced cards differ in cost, stats, guard and optional entry ability; this does not isolate any single mechanic.
Education combinations remain part of each deck. Their independent contribution cannot be separated by this comparison.
Normal bots with equal styles are not human players or all possible opponent builds.
